findings.claim: The node carries sourceTypes 'official_site' while its only sourceUrl is the FiscalData dataset, which is not this branch's official site. The verifier's own record shows no page was ever read: congress.gov answered 403. The unsupported source type feeds a confidenceScore of 0.7 and a verificationStatus of 'partial'. 41 nodes in the published graph are in this state.
findings.proposedAction: Pipeline, not curation: an 'official_site' source type should require a URL that is not the Treasury dataset. Audit the other 40 nodes with the same shape before changing anything.

findings.claim: Typed 'Division'. senate.gov was read and does not label a unit of this name, so this may be an editorial grouping of leadership posts rather than a body the Senate itself names.
findings.proposedAction: Curator: confirm whether the Senate names a body of this kind. If it does not, the type or the name should say that this is a grouping, as the count-labelled groupings elsewhere in the graph now do.
